figures.name: revision-class-robustness
figures.caption: All23 unknown classes, with unique confirmation-flow counts in parentheses. (a) Dynamic HQR minus rolling-global class-specific rejection. (b) Corresponding difference in the macro after removing that class from its own population: two remaining background groups or19 remaining held-out services. Orange/blue distinguish background/held-out classes. Intervals are paired28-calendar-day bootstrap95% intervals, conditional on the same traffic and fixed model/audit cells. Negative and positive effects are all retained. Class rarity and valid bootstrap draws are reported in the full source table.

figures.name: revision-monthly-effects
figures.caption: Post-confirmation monthly composition and paired Dynamic HQR minus rolling-global effects. Unknown detection is a period macro within each month. Intervals use2000 paired7-calendar-day block resamples within the month, not independent model seeds. Missing dates remain absent observations. Differences between month estimates are descriptive and are not a tested time-interaction effect.
